title: Syn2RealTrack: Bridging the Gap Between Synthetic and Real-World Datasets for Online Multi-View Multi-Target Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2608.24130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-camera 3D perception systems for warehouse scenes are trained largely on synthetic data and evaluated on physically captured environments. The resulting synthetic-to-real gap, which corrupts ground-plane localization and cross-camera identity association, is usually treated as one deficiency for a single domain-adaptation module to absorb; we argue instead that it enters the pipeline at three separable points: the camera calibration, the object shape prior, and the assumption that the object census is known, each admitting a different local remedy. translated_title: Syn2RealTrack：弥合合成数据集与真实世界数据集之间的差距，用于在线多视角多目标跟踪
translated_abstract: 用于仓库场景的多相机3D感知系统主要基于合成数据进行训练，并在物理捕获的环境中进行评估。由此产生的合成到真实的差距，会破坏地面平面定位和跨相机身份关联，通常被视为单一领域自适应模块需要吸收的一个缺陷；我们则认为，这种差距在三个可分离的点进入流程：相机标定、物体形状先验，以及假设目标数量已知，每个点都可采用不同的局部补救措施。我们的在线流程Syn2RealTrack遵循这一分解：在未提供标定的情况下仅从图像中恢复镜头畸变；通过一种基于可见性加权的部位描述符进行跨视角检测融合，该描述符对遮挡部位选择弃权而非猜测；人体高度从标定中以闭合形式测量，而非从合成先验中复制；此外，[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 该论文提出Syn2RealTrack，将合成到真实的差距分解为三个可分别补救的环节（相机标定、物体形状先验、目标数量假设），通过针对性策略实现鲁棒的在线多视角多目标跟踪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Syn2RealTrack, which decomposes the synthetic-to-real gap into three separately addressable stages (camera calibration, object shape prior, and object census assumption) and applies targeted remedies for robust online multi-view multi-target tracking.
